features.description: Render the extractor-coverage + confidence block at the top of the Architecture page: confidence ceiling, per-extractor status, and present-but-unextracted kinds, so an incomplete map states its incompleteness loudly.
features.acceptance: the Architecture page renders a coverage banner showing the confidence ceiling, each extractor's status, and any missing-extractor kinds from the view-state coverage block; a low or medium ceiling is rendered as an explicit incompleteness statement, never hidden; the banner is driven only by real coverage data (no hard-coded high).

features.description: Render the intent layer (declared ADR claims) alongside the as-built graph and surface each diff entry by its taxonomy as a drift badge; intent is labelled declared and an empty intent layer reads as no-ADRs, never as confident as-built.
features.acceptance: the page renders intent claims distinctly labelled as declared/intended (not as-built fact), shows each diff entry's taxonomy as a drift badge (aligned / documented_unimplemented / stale_adr), and renders an honest empty state when there are no claims; nothing presents intent as observed evidence.

features.description: Real-shell journey: boot the actual dashboard shell on a producer-built view-state and assert the Architecture surface renders the coverage banner + intent claims + diff honestly through the real render path.
features.acceptance: a journey test boots the real shell (createJarvis init) on a producer-generated architecture view-state and asserts the rendered Architecture surface shows the coverage banner, at least one declared intent claim, and the diff, with no raw JSON leaked and no over-confident/fake-fresh rendering.
